## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I based this change on the current `main` branch and reviewed the diff for unrelated changes.
- [ ] I preserved useful existing material and avoided duplicating content.
- [ ] Technical claims use primary research, standards, specifications, or official documentation where practical.
- [ ] Examples contain no credentials, private data, or realistic secrets.
- [ ] Code and notebooks are deterministic and locally runnable where the lesson promises that behavior.
- [ ] README, notebook, code, asset, and navigation paths agree.
- [ ] Diagrams and pages remain readable and accessible at relevant screen sizes.
- [ ] I did not weaken authorization, safety, or release gates to make a test pass.
